note: Loyalty and drift (M6, docs/POLITICS.md). Values 0-1; rates per year. Texts: loyalty.* and dispatch.politics.* in src/i18n/locales.

stages.note: value >= threshold: that stage; below 'autonomous' a colony may secede

push.note: latency: per ly of light delay to the capital; neglect: after grace years without word from the capital, rate x min(cap, (years - grace) / 50); instability: x the colony's instability; hunger/unrest: while it lasts; disaster: once per disaster; selfSufficiency: x resilience (large peoples need the empire less)

pull.note: base: always; prosperity: while fed (food >= 1) and free of famine and unrest; directive: each order received (at most once a year); mission: a cultural mission arriving

autonomy.note: the governance.autonomy directive: tight control chafes, broad autonomy relieves (but a broad governor ignores low-priority orders)

restless.note: restless colonies ignore low-priority orders and work less (colonies.json restlessIndustry)

secession.note: yearly chance to declare independence while below the autonomous threshold (only peoples of at least minPopulation, who can stand alone); autonomous colonies of the same empire within joinRange ly join the new polity
